source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Presenting Findings Clearly' under topic 7.7 (PDF 103, printed 99).

blocks.text: Nataij wazeh pesh karne se parhne wale research ke nataij aasani se samajhte hain. Nataij mantiqi aur munazzam (structured) tareeqe se tarteeb diye jayein. Wazahat ke liye tables, charts aur graphs use kiye ja sakte hain. Technical jargon (mushkil takneeki alfaaz) ki jagah saadi zaban use ho. Aham nukaat numayan kiye jayein. Wazeh pesh-kash uljhan kam aur baat-cheet behtar karti hai, aur research ko zyada mufeed banati hai.
